sections.title: Preventive and Interceptive Orthodontics II Clinic
sections.description: The Preventive and Interceptive Clinic rotation consists of seven sessions in the Orthodontic clinic. During each rotation, students are assigned a minimum of two hours in a clinical setting and an additional hour or more in seminar to review the day's cases and any additional treatment planning information (ie, cephalometrics, space analysis). Through these rotations, students are exposed to patients with malocclusions that arise in a normally developing craniofacial complex.
